Local evidence: 42% reported difficulty accessing primary care; 54% of residents and 58% of leaders said primary care access worsened
PFAC implementation action: Create a standing PFAC access and navigation agenda lane and require each issue to receive a documented leadership disposition
Host validation required: Confirm current PFAC agenda pathway and assign accountable sponsor
Proposed measure: Percent of access/navigation items with owner, disposition, and report-back

Local evidence: 72% of leaders/service providers cited insufficient local capacity; 44% cited long waits or limited office hours
PFAC implementation action: Route recurring capacity and wait-time themes to the responsible operational leader before the next PFAC meeting
Host validation required: Validate escalation route and operational owner
Proposed measure: Median days from PFAC signal to leadership disposition

Local evidence: 59% of leaders/service providers identified difficulty navigating the health care system
PFAC implementation action: Use PFAC review to identify high-friction navigation points and document one testable improvement action per reviewed pathway
Host validation required: Select first navigation pathway for host use
Proposed measure: Number of navigation issues reviewed and actions closed

Local evidence: 55% of community leaders identified homebound or very rural populations as not adequately served
PFAC implementation action: Build remote participation, caregiver input, transportation, scheduling, and technology alternatives into recruitment and meeting design
Host validation required: Validate participation options and recruitment channels

Local evidence: Service area is 72,736 people across 19 municipalities; 22% are age 65+ and 12% have a disability
PFAC implementation action: Use service-area demographic variation to set recruitment and participation checks instead of assuming a single patient voice is representative
Host validation required: Compare current PFAC composition with service-area context
Proposed measure: Documented representation review completed at defined cadence

Local evidence: CMS Patient Safety Structural Measure Domain 5 emphasizes patient and family engagement infrastructure
PFAC implementation action: Link the access/navigation workstream to local evidence, accountable role, action, and validation source
Host validation required: Validate local evidence used for organizational attestation or improvement
Proposed measure: Percent of mapped elements with validated local evidence
